DENIA-DENIA.title: Denia
DENIA-DENIA.description:
If one persists long enough, every story must reach a good ending, must it not?
"I will wait for you at the terminal."
In Black Form, Denia can enhance card effects with Virtual Matter and Dark Core.
DENIA-DENIA.banter.dead.endTurnPing: Someone is still... waiting for me...
